title: The harmonic structure of the twist sectors
claim: On square-lattice tori with periods (Lh, 0) and (s, Lv), shearing by Lh relabels the twist sectors (a, b) -> (a, a + b) and the mirror maps shear s to -s, pathwise for every orientation. Hence, for P_ab = P(all strong components contractible), E = P00 - P01, P00 + P01 and P10 + P11 are even and Lh-periodic in s and carry only whole harmonics, while O = P10 - P11 is even and Lh-antiperiodic and carries only half-integer harmonics, with O(Lh/2) = 0; the second difference is E - O, so additivity at half shear holds exactly when P00 = P01. In twisted sectors P(consistent) = 1 - P(contractible) - P(odd winding), so the consistency relation is equivalent to D = odd10 + odd01 - odd11. None of the measured large-size relations holds exactly on the 3 x 3 torus.
failure_conditions: An orientation whose sectors disagree with their relabelled sectors after a shear by Lh, or with the mirrored and gauge-fixed sectors.
At half shear, an orientation whose (1, 0)-sector differs from the (1, 1)-sector of its mirrored image.
On the 3 x 3 torus, contractible and cross counts that differ, or consistency different from 1 - contractible - odd winding.
foundation_claim_scope: Twist sectors of uniform random orientations of square-lattice tori; exact covariance and its harmonic consequences. Lattices are declared; no space or physics is claimed.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies Theorem 1 (a), (b) and (c) pathwise on 1,150 sampled orientations of six tori (4 x 3 s = 1, 4 x 4 s = 2, 5 x 4 s = 2, 6 x 4 s = 3, 6 x 5 s = 1, 5 x 5 s = -2) in all four sectors, with zero mismatches in kind, oddness and mapped class; enumerates all 2^18 orientations of the 3 x 3 torus at shears 0 and 1 to confirm the duality identities exactly and the failure of the four large-size relations, and records the odd-line counts (Conjecture 6 holds there); two controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and sampled checks
